decision_conditions: Prior to installation of mechanical plant works, an acoustic report, written in line with the methodology in BS4142:2014+A1 2019, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The report must set out the sound level generated from the mechanical plant and state the noise control measures to be employed to ensure the noise from the plant does not exceed a level of 5dB below the typical measured background noise level measured as L(A)90 15 minutes during operational hours, at the façade of the nearest or most noise affected residential property.Reason: To protect the local amenity from noise and disturbance

Prior to installation of the lift works, specifications, plans and sections of the fire evacuation lifts and a management plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the details approved and maintained as such thereafter.Reason: In the interests of fire safety and to ensure the safety of all building users
